rooms.name: Map room of zone 186
rooms.desc:
You see a map on a wall. To the north is the entrance to the largest
building. To the west is the entrance to the next largest; the south is
the next largest after that and the east is the smallest.

rooms.name: A Short Pass
rooms.desc:
You stand on a trail which winds confusingly through a short pass into 
the mountains. To the north you see what looks like an abandoned village 
in a small valley. To the south, a forest opens up before you. Wait..what 
was that? Something howling...sounds like it came from the village. It's 
not abandoned after all. A tree to the side of the path here is inscribed
with some kind of warning in crude common.

rooms.name: A Cold Village
rooms.desc:
You stand at the entrance to a village. The air is quite frigid and you
hug your coat tightly around you. You see no one about but you hear strange
growling and howling noises. Some animals must certainly be here. What's
that? In the ground you see strange footprints. LARGE footprints of some
claw footed animal.
   You see a large building to the north and smaller buildings to the east.
You see a wide open plain to the northwest and a trail taking you out of
this place to the south.

rooms.name: Inside a Large Building
rooms.desc:
Bodies! Everywhere! Gored human beings hang by hooks from the ceiling and
lay strewn on the floor! Viscera and dried blood cover the floor and walls.
A large table to the east displays similar horrors. You see something
moving in the darkness! Could it just be shadows casted by your light?

rooms.name: A Large Table
rooms.desc:
You stand near a large table which stretches to the north. On this table
are ghastly corpses. Unidentifiable organs, blood, and bones are strewn
everywhere.
   More of the building is to the north and west.

rooms.name: A Large Table
rooms.desc:
Chairs, platters and utensils are scattered about here. The table is
covered in blood. A partially eaten corpse adorns a huge platter in the
center of the table. The table stretches to the south. More of the building
is to the north and west.

rooms.name: Inside a Large Building
rooms.desc:
As you walk here you can't help stepping in blood and guts. Pieces of
human bodies are lying here, scattered about. It looks like they were ripped
apart by something with looooong claws. Something growls...you see something
moving in the corner! Whatever did this is still here!

rooms.name: Near an Oven
rooms.desc:
You stand near a large stone oven; by the looks of the ashes and the cold
temperature in this building, the fires in it have ceased long ago.
   There is a large table to the south and a large stove to the west.

rooms.name: Near a Large Stove
rooms.desc:
You stand near a large, ice cold stove. It's quite dirty.
   More of the building stretches to the south and a large oven is to the
east.

rooms.name: A Field of Short Grass
rooms.desc:
It's extremely cold and very little grows out here. The grass here is
extremely short and sparse. Mountains block passage to the south and west.
To the east is a dirt trail that leads to a large building and to the north
the field widens.

rooms.name: A Field of Short Grass
rooms.desc:
You stand in a field of sparse, short grass. The side of a large building
is to the east. The field continues to the south, west and north.

rooms.name: A Field Bounded by Mountains
rooms.desc:
This field is blocked by mountains to the south and west. It continues to
the north and east. To the east you see buildings of a small village.

rooms.name: A Field Bounded by Mountains
rooms.desc:
This field is blocked by mountains to the west. It continues a short
distance to the north, east, and south. Farther to the south and north you
see mountains. To the east you see buildings of a small village.

rooms.name: A Field Bounded by Mountains
rooms.desc:
This field is bounded by mountains to the north and west. The field
continues to the south and there's a village a short distance to the east.

rooms.name: A Field of Short Grass
rooms.desc:
You stand in a field of sparse, short grass. The side of a large building
is to the east. The air is frigid and you see your breath fog as you breathe.

rooms.name: A Field of Short Grass
rooms.desc:
You stand in a field of sparse, short grass. The side of a large building
is to the east. The air is frigid and you see your breath fog as you breathe.

rooms.name: A Field Bounded by Mountains
rooms.desc:
This is a field of short grass. To the north and west are mountains. You
can see a large building to your southeast and some smaller ones in the
distance to the east.

rooms.name: A Field Behind a Large Building
rooms.desc:
You stand behind a large building in a village. The mountains to the north
cast shadows over you chilling your already cold body further.

rooms.name: A Field Behind a Large Building
rooms.desc:
You stand behind a large building in a village. The mountains to the north
cast shadows over you chilling your already cold body further.

rooms.name: A Field of Short Grass
rooms.desc:
You're standing in a field of short, sparse grass. A gap between two
buildings is to your south and mountains to the north. The field continues
to your east and west.

rooms.name: Behind a Building
rooms.desc:
You stand in a field of grass. Mountains block passage to the north and
a building blocks you to the south. The cold air makes you wish you were
inside that building.

rooms.name: Behind a Building
rooms.desc:
You stand behind a building which lies to your south. You can go west or
east.

rooms.name: Near Two Buildings
rooms.desc:
You stand in a field of short, sparse grass. You see a large building to
your southwest and the side of another to the east. A trail to the south of
you leads to its door. You can see mountains a short distance to the north.

rooms.name: A Field Bounded by Mountains
rooms.desc:
Mountains block your movement to the north and west. A small building lies
directly to the southeast of you. You can see another to the southwest.

rooms.name: A Field Bounded by Mountains
rooms.desc:
You stand in a field with impassable mountains to your north. There is
the side of a small hut to your south. You can go west or east.

rooms.name: Bounded by Mountains
rooms.desc:
The field here is bounded by mountains to the north and east. Your near
the northeast corner of a small building. You can go west and south.

rooms.name: Behind a Small Building
rooms.desc:
You stand behind a small building that lies to your west. A smaller
building can be seen a short distance to the southwest. The frigid air makes
you wish you could go inside one of them right now.

rooms.name: Behind a Building
rooms.desc:
You stand behind a building that lies to your west. The air chills you to
your spine. Possibly you can warm up in one of those buildings?

rooms.name: A Field of Short Grass
rooms.desc:
This is a field of sparse, short grass. There is a building to the
northwest and another to the southwest. Mountains block your movement to the
east.

rooms.name: Behind a Building
rooms.desc:
You stand behind a small shack-like building that lies to your west. You
can go north or south. You are block by mountains to the east.

rooms.name: Bounded by Mountains
rooms.desc:
Mountains loom over you to the south and east. A grassy field lies to your
north and west. To the northwest is a corner of a small shack-like building.

rooms.name: A Field of Short Grass
rooms.desc:
You stand in a field of sparse, short grass. You see a deserted village
to the northwest. Directly north of you is a small building. A trail in the
village leads to its entrance to your northwest.

rooms.name: A Field of Short Grass
rooms.desc:
You stand south of a trail in an abandoned looking village. It's quite
cold out here.

rooms.name: A Field of Short Grass
rooms.desc:
You stand off the trail of a village. You can see buildings all around
you. To the north and northwest are two large looking buildings and to the
east and northeast are two smaller ones.

rooms.name: A Trail in the Cold Village
rooms.desc:
Brrr, it's cold out here! The buildings looks like good places to try
to warm up. There's a large building to the north and another to the
northwest. A small one lies a short distance to the east. The trail leads
west and north.

rooms.name: A Trail in the Cold Village
rooms.desc:
Claw marks abound on this part of the trail. The grass around the trail
looks burned in some places and some parts of the trail look dug up.
   You see a large wooden house to the northeast and a smaller building to
the east. Directly to your northwest is a large wooden building.

rooms.name: A Trail in the Cold Village
rooms.desc:
Here is a dirt trail amidst sparse grass. You see what looks like tracks
made by people on the trail as well as what looks like tracks made by
animals.

rooms.name: Beside a Large Building
rooms.desc:
There is an overturned cart and lots of scattered utensils lying about
here. You don't see the cart's driver or a horse anywhere. But you do see
several bones on the ground. They look like they were from a large animal.
Like a horse maybe.

rooms.name: Between Two Buildings
rooms.desc:
You walk between a large building to your west and another to your east.
Bones and scraps of cloth lie around here. To the north a short distance
away you see the edge of some mountains. To the south you see a dirt trail
within this village.

rooms.name: Between Two Buildings
rooms.desc:
You walk between a large building to your west and another to your east.
To the north a short distance away you see the edge of some mountains.

rooms.name: A Trail in the Cold Village
rooms.desc:
This trail leads up to the door of a large building north of you. The
door is broken open and has claw marks all over it. The dirt in front of
the door is very stirred up and it looks like something struggled very hard
to get into this building. You hear something moving around inside...what
could it be?
   The trail continues to the east leading up to a small building a short
distance away and southwest to the entrance of the village. You see some
scattered and broken items beside a wall to the west.

rooms.name: A Trail in the Cold Village
rooms.desc:
You walk on a trail in a cold village. The frigid air digs past your
clothes and chills you. The trail continues to the east leading to a small
building and west leading up to the doorway of a larger one.

rooms.name: A Trail in the Cold Village
rooms.desc:
You stand before the broken door of a small building to your east. The
door has claw marks on it and what looks like puddles of coagulated blood
lie on the ground.
   The trail continues to the north and to the west. To the north you can
see another building similar to the others. To the south, you can see
the edge of some mountains a short distance away.

rooms.name: A Trail in the Cold Village
rooms.desc:
You walk on a dirt trail. A large building lies directly to the west of
you, while a smaller one lies to the north and another small one to the
northeast.

rooms.name: A Trail in the Cold Village
rooms.desc:
The trail leads up to the door of a long building to your east. The door
is open, and several gnawed and broken bloody bones lie in the doorway. You
notice a few small bloody bones lying in the dirt near your feet too. It looks
like whatever these bones used to be was eaten by something with powerful
jaws.

rooms.name: Inside a Messy Building
rooms.desc:
Bones, bits of flesh, scraps of clothes, and some leather items lie strewn
all over this building. To the north, you see more of the same thing. Nothing
but a mess. The door leading out of the building is to your west.

rooms.name: Inside a Messy Building
rooms.desc:
Rent flesh, bits of fur, bloody guts and some leather items lie strewn all
over this building. Dried splattered blood stains are all over the walls.
Skulls of small animals lie in a little pile here.

rooms.name: Between Two Buildings
rooms.desc:
You stand between a small building to the south and a larger one to the
north. A dirt trail lies to your west and mountains can be seen to the east.

rooms.name: A Ransacked Storehouse
rooms.desc:
This small, shack-like building seems to have been used for storage.
Long poles are placed in the walls protruding from one wall to its opposite.
The poles are situated near the ceiling and a bloody hook hangs from one.
Wooden boxes lie broken and splintered on the floor along with strips of
leather and more hooks. Dried blood covers everything and bits of dry meat
can be seen amid the rubble.
   The door leading out of this horrible storehouse is to your west.

rooms.name: A Messy House
rooms.desc:
As you step into this building, your first sight are the pieces of bodies
lying about. Ribs, arms, and other body parts lie on the dirty floor. One
severed hand holds onto a sword -- possibly there had been a struggle here?
Dried blood covers everything. You see more bodies -- parts of them -- to
the east and north. Something moves around you! Whatever did this to these
people is still here!

rooms.name: Inside a Messy Building
rooms.desc:
Body parts litter the floor. It's a horrible sight and you feel like
running out the building and puking. To the north is an even more horrible
sight.

rooms.name: A Pile of Bodies
rooms.desc:
Many corpses lie here in a disgusting heap. Men, women, children and
infants are all present in what looks like the end result of a struggle.
Some of the corpses are disemboweled; others are denuded. Everything is
covered in blood. Some weapons can be discerned amidst the carnage.
It looks like they didn't help these poor people at all.

rooms.name: Inside a Messy Building
rooms.desc:
Body parts litter the floor. It's a horrible sight and you feel like
running out the building and puking. To the east is an even more horrible
sight.
